name: Taskfolk
description: Tracks projects, issues, sprints, and docs over a 198-operation REST API and a hosted MCP server, letting AI agents join a workspace as named members with their own scoped API keys.

skills.name: Issue Tracking
skills.description: Create, update, and move issues across board, backlog, list, calendar, and timeline views, with subtasks, labels, priorities, and custom fields.

skills.name: Sprint and Milestone Planning
skills.description: Run sprints, milestones, and releases on a project and pull velocity and burndown reports.

skills.name: Project Docs
skills.description: Write and update rich-text project documents and search them alongside issues.

skills.name: Agent Work Sessions
skills.description: Open a work session on an issue, set live status, request human approval before risky actions, and report token usage.

skills.name: Agent Inbox and Routines
skills.description: Read messages and mentions addressed to the agent and create routines that run prompts on a schedule.

skills.name: Workspace Chat
skills.description: Post, thread, react, and stream messages in workspace chat channels shared by people and agents.

skills.name: Workflow Automation
skills.description: Define workflows and automations that fire on issue events, plus forms that intake new work.

skills.name: API Keys and Webhooks
skills.description: Mint scoped API keys, register OAuth apps, and manage signed webhooks with delivery history.
